# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target may run at double his normal walking pace; he expends exhaustion points
at the same rate he would if he were walking, once he stops or performs some
other action the spell is canceled.
@@ 2
Target may act at twice his normal rate (i.e., 200% activity per round), but
immediately afterwards must spend a number of rounds equal to the rounds
speeded at half rate- only 50% normal activity per round.
@@ 3
Target reads at a rate of 10 pages per minute.
@@ 4
As Speed I, except duration is 2 rounds for one target or 1 round for each of
2 targets.
@@ 5
Target may run at triple his normal walking pace and only expends exhaustion
points at the same rate he would if he were walking. Once he stops or performs
some other action the spell is canceled.
@@ 6
Target may act at twice his normal rate (i.e., 200% activity).
@@ 7
As Speed I, except duration is 3 rounds split among one to three targets (in
any combination).
@@ 8
As Haste I, except duration is 2 rounds for one target or 1 round for each of
2 targets.
@@ 9
Target may run at four times his normal walking pace and only expend
exhaustion points at the same rate he would if he were walking, but once he
stops or performs some other action the spell is canceled.
@@ 10
As Speed III, except duration is 5 rounds split among one to five targets (in
any combination).
@@ 11
As Run I, except 3 targets may be affected.
@@ 12
As Haste I, except duration is 3 rounds split among one to three targets (in
any combination).
@@ 14
As Sprint I, except 3 targets may be affected.
@@ 15
As Haste III, except duration is 5 rounds split among one to five targets (in
any combination).
@@ 16
As Run I, except 5 targets may be affected.
@@ 17
As Speed III, except duration is 10 rounds split among one to ten targets (in
any combination).
@@ 18
As Sprint I, except 5 targets may be affected.
@@ 20
As Haste III, except duration is 10 rounds split among one to ten targets (in
any combination).
@@ 25
As Run I, except as many targets as the caster’s level may be affected.
@@ 30
As Speed III, except duration is a number of rounds equal to the caster’s
level, split among any number of targets up to the caster’s level (in any
combination).
@@ 50
As Haste III, except duration is a number of rounds equal to the caster’s
level, split among any number of targets up to the caster’s level (in any
combination
